<!-- Generated by codeflower-app's cmd/gendocs: do not edit. -->

Download the sandbox image ghcr.io/lutrarutra/codeflower-sandbox:0.18.0, the release this app is made for; --image-tag downloads another release (latest for the newest, or 0.9 for the newest patch of 0.9) or a commit's build, or updates one. "codeflower interactive", "codeflower run" and "codeflower task" download it on first use; on a cluster, run this once on the login node, as compute nodes often have no internet access. Apptainer keeps it in ~/codeflower/images as codeflower-sandbox_vX.Y.Z-sha-abc1234.sif (set CODEFLOWER_IMAGE_DIR to keep it elsewhere).

Claude Code is not in the image, whose license does not allow passing it on: this also downloads the version the image needs from npm into ~/codeflower/agents (set CODEFLOWER_AGENTS_DIR to keep it elsewhere).


## Usage

```sh
codeflower pull [flags]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--engine string` | `auto` | engine to download it for: auto, docker, podman, or apptainer |
| `--image-tag string` |  | build of the published image to use instead of 0.18.0, the release this app is made for: latest, another release (0.2.1, or 0.2 for its newest patch) or a commit (sha-abc1234) (or set $CODEFLOWER_IMAGE_TAG) |
